facts.fact: 妹妹把同事 Ash 与 Mallory 招呼上这辆脚踏酒吧车，一次租下一个半小时。
facts.anchor: Jess waves Ash and Mallory over to the pedal tavern that’s ours for the next hour and a half.

facts.fact: 导游给的操作口令只有这一句——像骑自行车那样蹬。
全场只有她一个人保持清醒。
facts.anchor: Being the only sober one in our group will be interesting.

facts.fact: 首席伴娘的职责要求她完全清醒：保证新娘玩得开心，必要时跟家长对接。
facts.anchor: But as maid of honor, it’s my job to make sure the bride has fun and to interface with the appropriate grown-ups when necessary. I need to be completely sober for that.

facts.fact: 她脑子里有一只秒表在倒数，剩下的时间不多。
facts.anchor: There’s a stopwatch counting down minutes in my head, and I don’t have much time left before time runs out.

facts.fact: 酒吧吧台上，Daniel 独自喝着一杯鸡尾酒，把注意力全给了台上的歌手。
facts.anchor: I do a double take when I see Daniel sitting at the bar in his usual suit and tie, nursing a cocktail, giving the singer his full attention.

facts.fact: 他承认自己查了那趟脚踏车的路线，并沿线一家家酒吧找过去。
facts.anchor: I might have checked the route that horrific alcohol death-trap bus thing was taking and popped into a few of the bars along its route.

facts.fact: 妹妹在真心话大冒险里当众问他，什么时候爱上她姐姐。
facts.anchor: “When did you first fall for my sister?”
